name: a5-100m-port-s1s2
setup: set -e; python3 -m venv /opt/p2venv; /opt/p2venv/bin/pip install -q torch==2.7.0 numpy tokenizers==0.21.1 transformers==4.51.3 safetensors matplotlib pytest; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.data.prepare --download --splits train_10M,train_100M,dev; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -x babylm/tests; if [ -n "${RESTORE_URI:-}" ]; then mkdir -p babylm/runs; gsutil -m -q rsync -r "$RESTORE_URI" babylm/runs; fi; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_twin_ref-0026.py babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py; mkdir -p babylm/moonshot; [ -f babylm/moonshot/__init__.py ] || touch babylm/moonshot/__init__.py; gsutil -q cp __BUCKET__/code/dev_bpw_dump_ref-0034.py babylm/moonshot/dev_bpw_dump.py; echo  | base64 -d > babylm/configs/jobs_a5_100m_port.json; echo '8dad5527ff8c1c1de9c031eda3964a9b804042e6bd534cac07136e20599168cf  babylm/configs/jobs_a5_100m_port.json' | sha256sum -c -
note: A5 100M reference per critic 23:12Z: the port recipe (T100 = grid_S_100M_e10_s0, best registered 100M point) gets an A100 full-DEV temps re-dump of the existing s0 export (T100_S0_HF_URI = the grid_S_100M_e10_s0 score/hf export the CPU dump used; its sha256 list is kept) plus seeds 1 and 2 trained with the identical port args (jobs_a5_100m_port.json, sha 8dad5527ff8c, written in setup). Same instrument as the S E6 pool: dev_bpw_twin.json + dev_bpw_dump --twin --temps @ref-0034. T100 = 3-seed mean of cal_t FULL DEV; label 'best of registered 100M points; not fully tuned, so x is an UPPER BOUND'. Grid b/c stay stopped. Copy runs/<run>/score/dev_bpw_twin.json, pt_v2 and loss curves (curve.csv/png) to reads. | Executor 3: s0 redump split out to project-c (its export is only readable there); this bin = s1+s2 on project-b.

jobs.name: a5port_S_100M_e10_s1
jobs.cmd: /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_a5_100m_port.json --only a5port_S_100M_e10_s1; rc=$?; /opt/p2venv/bin/python -m babylm.analysis.post_runs --pt_runs a5port_S_100M_e10_s1; [ -f babylm/runs/a5port_S_100M_e10_s1/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/a5port_S_100M_e10_s1 /opt/babylm || echo '[a5] score a5port_S_100M_e10_s1 failed'; mkdir -p babylm/runs/a5port_S_100M_e10_s1/score babylm/runs/a5port_S_100M_e10_s1/pt_v2; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python babylm/eval/dev_bpw_twin.py babylm/runs/a5port_S_100M_e10_s1/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --slice full --ws collapse --line_join newline --out babylm/runs/a5port_S_100M_e10_s1/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/a5port_S_100M_e10_s1/score/dev_bpw_twin.log 2>&1 || echo '[twin] a5port_S_100M_e10_s1 failed'; /opt/babylm/venv/bin/python -m babylm.moonshot.dev_bpw_dump babylm/runs/a5port_S_100M_e10_s1/score/hf /opt/babylm/osf/text_data/dev/dev --ws collapse --line_join newline --twin --temps 0.9,0.95,1.05,1.1,1.15,1.2 --out babylm/runs/a5port_S_100M_e10_s1/pt_v2/dev_v2.npz --check babylm/runs/a5port_S_100M_e10_s1/score/dev_bpw_twin.json > babylm/runs/a5port_S_100M_e10_s1/pt_v2/dump.log 2>&1 || echo '[ptv2] a5port_S_100M_e10_s1 failed'; }; exit $rc
